outlook.statement: Resolution plan was duly approved by the members of the Committee of Creditors in the 17th meeting and is pending for approval before the Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench.

Currently the company is undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process and it is under process to get approval of the Hon'ble NCLT on the resolution plan received from the Resolution Applicant as approved by CoC members.

In view of the smooth progress of the ongoing CIRP and submission of successful Resolution Plan by PRA to continue the operations of the Company post approval of the NCLT in line with the provisions of the IBC, these financial statements have been presented on a 'going concern basis.'

The future prospects of the Company would be determined on the completion of CIRP. Hence, in view of the above facts and considering the smooth progress of the CIRP with the submission of the Resolution Plan of the prospective Resolution Applicant (PRA), as approved by the CoC, for the final approval of the Tribunal as of date, these financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis.

The future prospects of the Company would be determined on the completion of CIRP. Financial statements prepared on going concern basis considering smooth progress of CIRP with submission of Resolution Plan approved by CoC for final approval of Tribunal.

litigation: Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) initiated by NCLT Mumbai Bench on 29th January 2021 based on petition filed by Anand Rathi Global Finance Limited under section 7 of IBC, 2016

The Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal ("NCLT"), Mumbai Bench, has by its order dated January 29, 2021 admitted the petition for initiation of the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process ("CIRP") under Section 7 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 ("the Code") filed by the financial creditor, namely, Anand Rathi Global Finance Limited.

In the 17th meeting of the Committee of Creditors ("CoC"), the resolution plan was approved by the requisite majority of the members of the Committee of Creditors in terms of Section 30(4) of the Code, and the application for approval of the said resolution plan under Section 30(6) read with Section 31 of the Code is pending consideration before the Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench.
